rationale: Codebase-pattern-finder evidence: Option A reuses the established CLAUDE.md-to-docs/guides pointer pattern (Loop Authoring already points at HARNESS_OPTIMIZATION_GUIDE.md); Option B (single reference skill) has no precedent — no SKILL.md in this repo is purely reference-only, and skill descriptions are single-intent triggers, so a 3-topic skill would over-fire or under-fire. rule: Option A — skill-per-domain, using existing docs/guides pointer pattern where it already exists
alternatives_rejected: Option B — single reference skill holding all three migrated sections
